reviews.review_title: Bright, fun and clearly made with care
reviews.review_description: Glitch Glide City is colourful, fast-paced and genuinely enjoyable to play. The world has loads of personality, the characters look brilliant, and exploring the city feels energetic rather than repetitive. I’m especially impressed that the developer listens to player feedback and continues expanding and improving the game. It already has a strong foundation, and the latest update makes it feel even bigger and more polished. Definitely worth trying.
